slots.notes: Fixed fullscreen looping background video behind everything (object-cover, muted, autoplay, playsInline); sits at z-0 under the entire page. Placeholder is a CloudFront MP4.
Brand wordless logo mark rendered inline in the navbar (and reusable elsewhere). Native is a 4-quadrant curve SVG on a 256x256 viewBox, single-color white fill via currentColor; tints to fg.

mechanic: Single sticky fullscreen looping video backdrop under a dark glassy page whose hero word is a noise-filtered animated linear-gradient shimmer (animate-shiny), with liquid-glass bordered cards, a realistic macOS inbox mockup, and a yearly/monthly pricing toggle over a giant gradient watermark headline.
techDelivery: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + motion/react (framer-motion v12) + lucide-react; Inter via Google Fonts @import; Pricing section uses bespoke hand-written CSS classes (c3-*) instead of Tailwind.
reskinNotes: Gradient hex stops (#091020/#0B2551/#A4F4FD/#00d2ff) are baked inline into the headline gradientStyle, the avatar bubble, the c3-watermark-line-2 CSS, and the inbox label dots, so accent reskins must be threaded through both inline JSX styles and the c3-* stylesheet. The hero shimmer depends on a 200% backgroundSize + SVG feTurbulence filter (id c3-noise duplicated at root and pricing scope) — re-theming must preserve both filter defs. All copy (nav links, hero/triage/CTA strings, the 6 inbox messages, 3 testimonials, 3 pricing plans with literal European-format prices) is hardcoded in markup. Pricing typography (9rem watermark, 580px card min-height, fixed letter-spacing) is metric-tuned for Inter and the c3-grid uses a translateX(20px) nudge. Brand name 'Aura' and plan copy referencing 'Forma' are inconsistent literals in the source.
